# Citefast

> Citefast is a free online citation generator that automatically formats citations in APA, MLA, and Chicago styles for academic writing and research.

Citefast provides students and academics with an easy-to-use tool for generating properly formatted bibliographies and reference lists across multiple citation styles. The platform supports APA 6th and 7th editions, MLA 8th edition, and Chicago 16th edition formatting standards.

## Key Topics

- Citation Generator
- APA (6th and 7th edition)
- MLA (8th edition)
- Chicago (16th edition)
- Bibliography Tool
